name: Vizzu
role: Animated charts that morph between chart types (bar, stacked, scatter) in a browser canvas, seekable
summary: Vizzu (vizzu npm package, C++ compiled to WASM) draws charts to a canvas and animates between chart states with chart.animate(), keeping each data marker as one object through bar, stacked, scatter, pie and similar changes. A keyframe array is one paused AnimControl whose seek() takes a time, so the harness can drive it from t. Strength: object-constant data-story transitions without hand-built tweens.
use_when: A data story where one set of marks morphs between chart types; over d3, which leaves transitions to the author
Bar, stacked and scatter views of one table as a single seekable timeline
A chart scene that must be captured frame by frame through packages/capture
avoid_when: Bespoke marks or full geometry control: d3 with SVG
A static chart image with no motion: vl-convert
Alpha output: the fixture draws on an opaque background and alpha is untested
notes: 2026-11-27: determinism needed the scene's seek to call control.seek twice; with one call, shuffled capture differed from sequential in 3 of 5 runs (one random frame each). Untested whether a longer settle fixes it instead.

assessment.rationale: npm vizzu 0.18.0 and GitHub v0.18.0 both 2026-04-20; repository last pushed the same day (7 months ago), not archived; Apache-2.0; 2,051 stars. Object-constant chart-type morphs that d3 and vl-convert lack; seekable via AnimControl.

evidence.result: 90 1280x720 frames of a 3 s bar, stacked, scatter keyframe chain seeked via AnimControl; shuffled equals sequential in 16 of 16 runs with a double seek, 2 of 5 with a single seek (one random frame differed); 69 to 70 distinct frames; frame 90 differs. Frames inspected.
evidence.scope: Paused keyframe chain seek on macOS arm64, Chromium via Playwright, screenshot route. Needs a double seek; opaque background only, no alpha; end-of-chain seek checked once; no other charts or fonts.
